notes.title: Gargoyle Doyle – A new narrative experience for fans of Madrid Noir
notes.notes:
If you loved the narrative depth and charm of Madrid Noir, then Gargoyle Doyle should be next on your list! This VR comedy invites viewers to step into an immersive story with lovingly annoying characters that will make them laugh, reflect and maybe cry... who knows ? 

[i]“Doyle is a grouchy, self-important gargoyle with a major chip on his shoulder. Relegated to a forgotten back alcove, he finds himself stuck next to Chet, a decorative metal rain gutter who never shuts up. After watching the world change around them for 800 years, both must confront who they really are and what their lives add up to.”[/i]

If you enjoyed diving into the mysterious atmosphere of Madrid Noir, you’ll love the charm and humor of Gargoyle Doyle !

[url=https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/gargoyle-doyle/26996687423309136/]Get Gargoyle Doyle on Meta Quest now ![/url]

[i]Avaible only in English, on Quest 2, 3 and 3S.[/i]

notes.title: Meet Madrid Noir!
notes.notes:
Hello VR storytelling [b]fans[/b]!

We are[b] so excited[/b] to bring [b]Madrid Noir to Steam! [/b]Madrid Noir is an animation from the heart. The brainchild of director [b]James Castillo[/b] (Character designer of Mitchells vs. The Machines, Sherlock Gnomes), Madrid Noir is an [b]immersive VR narrative [/b]featuring light [b]interactive moments.[/b] It is an experience that might be one of the first of its kind: [b]an homage to film noir and Madrid in animated VR. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41402480/413c1a76423a920214892091424b069924a99800.gif[/img]

The story shifts [b]across time [/b]periods, with easter eggs about Madrid culture woven throughout. Building up to our release (and then a little after), we will be sharing with you a little bit of what went into [b]the making of this project,[/b] starting with the writing of the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41402480/a92c40b72a0c53774c09344a7d25d6ed174f2bcf.gif[/img]

Check out this first video with interviews of the director, producers (No Ghost, Atlas V), and writers and find out more about the origin of the story. This is a behind the scenes look at the richness of the characters and a first look at the team behind the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41402480/8cf32be477b7a098e4527f33ac1417e20ebe6860.gif[/img]

In the next few weeks, we will be sharing [b]more videos, [/b]which altogether amount to a video series that will give you an [b]insight into VR filmmaking[/b] - the long, exciting, and ever-evolving journey of bringing an idea to life in virtual reality! 

Let us know your thoughts! We love to hear from you. 

Warmth, 
The Madrid Noir Team
